title: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Wedding Was Officiated by Adam Sandler
summary: The couple married on the evening of July 3.
contentText:
It’s a love story, baby, and they just said yes with friend Adam Sandler leading the ceremony! Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce exchanged vows at the world famous Madison Square Garden in New York City on Friday (July 3) with the actor-comedian as their officiant, according to a statement the pop superstar’s rep shared with Billboard .

While they had an A-list guest list, none of the bride and groom’s famous friends were part of their wedding party. Instead, the statement reveals that Swift’s brother, Austin, was her man of honor, while the Kansas City Chiefs tight end had brother Jason by his side as his best man.

As for their wedding looks — which had not yet been revealed as of press time, the statement shared that the outfits were created by Christian Dior Haute Couture and designed by Jonathan Anderson, who is the creative director of Dior Women’s, Men’s and Haute Couture Collections, with Swift and Kelce collaborating with him. Both the bride and groom wore custom Christian Louboutins, and the singer was bedazzled in Cartier.

Shortly after the couple exchanged vows, giant screens outside of MSG announced that they had both said “I do.” “JUST&T MARRIED!” read the screens. Among the many famous faces who were seen arriving at the venue for the wedding Friday were Jack Antonoff, Mariska Hargitay, Ed Sheeran, the Haim sisters, Benson Boone and Camila Cabello.

The football star proposed to the 14-time Grammy winner in August 2025. They announced in a joint Instagram post: “Your English teacher and your gym teacher are getting married!”
